lifecycle_root_cause: Pipeline evaluation did not express a mandatory market-context contract; the source loader resolved context 1 for bounded queries but omitted it from build_run_source_context, so snapshot construction persisted null temporal lineage.
ceri_root_cause: The durable capture job carried context 1 and matching cutoff/session/calendar, but execute_capture_run_job ignored those fields and invoked the optional capture API without market_cutoff, permitting its standalone now()-derived fallback.
internet_outage_partial_assessment: NO: Pipeline 141 became PARTIAL because all five complete combined rows contained analytical warning flags; stages and jobs completed without provider errors or retries.
internet_outage_temporal_assessment: NO: the lifecycle drop and CERI handler fallback are latent deterministic code defects and reproduced without network failure; the canary violations occurred during an uninterrupted execution.

new_findings.summary: The legacy CERI child-job chain did not preserve temporal payload fields across every provider/normalize/feature/capture/change/alert transition.
